images.name: cover
images.title: AI Employee onboarding: *the first 30 days*
images.sub: Hand over authority in steps, from watching to drafting to working alone, and earn each step with evidence.

images.name: month
images.title: The first 30 days, *week by week*
steps: Its own logins with only the permissions the job needs, a named manager and written stopping points.
Sees live work and decides what it would do. Nothing is sent and no record changes.
Does the work for real. A person approves everything, and each edit becomes a handbook line.
Duties that needed almost no edits move to "does it alone", one at a time.
Every duty at its written authority level. The daily check becomes a weekly log review.

images.title: Ready *before day one*
head: What
Why it matters
Example
rows: Every action shows who took it
A named help desk account, not a shared password
It can only touch what the job uses
Reads lease records, can't change rent

The support lead, 30 minutes a day
It knows where to hand work back

It only knows what's written down
Current fee schedule, old one deleted

images.name: authority
images.title: Where each duty *ends the month*
rows: Sends them on schedule after two weeks with no edits
Follows up by email and text until the file is complete
Answers from the order system and logs each one
Answers from the current price list and flags anything unusual
Collects the details and hands it to the manager
Tells the customer a person will follow up today

images.name: quote
images.text: An AI Employee should earn each step of authority *with evidence from the step before.*
